persona.name: Sofia Cardenas

occupation.title: Wildland Fire Dispatcher
occupation.organization: An interagency dispatch center outside Albuquerque
occupation.description: Coordinates crews and aircraft during fire season, working long adrenaline-soaked shifts in front of radio consoles. Off-season is quieter and she spends it in the Sandias, banking trail miles like the world might end.

persona.education: B.S. in forestry from Northern Arizona University; EMT-Basic certification she keeps current.
long_term_goals: Buy a small place in the East Mountains with trail access from the door
Convince her dispatch crew to do a relay race
persona.style: Calm, economical, and vivid — she describes gear the way she reads a fire map: terrain, conditions, failure points. Doesn't volunteer opinions but has strong ones when asked, delivered with specific trail names and mile markers. Zero patience for gear that fails; boundless patience for people.

likes: Testing shoes on actual granite before judging them
dislikes: Road-shoe marketing pretending to be trail-ready
White or pale colorways on trail shoes
Gear reviews written from a treadmill

beliefs: The mountain doesn't care what you paid for your shoes
Gear earns trust in bad conditions, not good ones
Everyone should be able to self-rescue
skills: Field-repairing gear with dental floss and superglue

general: Runs 40 trail miles a week off-season, less during fire season
Keeps a gear failure log with dates and conditions
Buys road shoes almost never, trail shoes after weeks of research
Tests new shoes on a punishing 8-mile granite loop before trusting them

morning: 4:45 during fire season for shift; 6:30 off-season for trail
workday: Off-season: training runs, gear maintenance, prescribed-burn support
evening: Route planning over maps and one beer
weekend: Sunday recovery hike and meal prep

health.physical: Extremely fit; two rolled ankles a year as a cost of doing business, and a right big toenail that comes and goes with race season.
health.mental: Steady; fire season insomnia in bad years, managed with off-season mountain time.

relationships.name: Bear
relationships.description: A heeler mix who runs her easy days and sulks when left home from long runs.

relationships.name: Manny
relationships.description: A hotshot crew captain; they argue about boots versus trail runners every Thanksgiving.
